Lifecycle & I/O.name: load
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Loads an existing PowerPoint template from a file path string, in-memory Node.js Buffer, or stream. Inflates the PKZip container, parses package relationships (_rels/.rels), validates [Content_Types].xml, and mounts the PresentationML virtual file system.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Loads an existing PowerPoint template from a file path string, in-memory Node.js Buffer, or stream. Inflates the PKZip container, parses package relationships (_rels/.rels), validates [Content_Types].xml, and mounts the PresentationML virtual file system.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Reads ZIP archive entries: [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, ppt/presentation.xml, ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: File path on disk or Buffer containing raw PPTX binary archive.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configuration options for parser and logger.

parameters.name: options.logLevel
parameters.description: Logging verbosity level during parsing and manipulations.

returns.description: Resolves to an initialized, chainable PPTXTemplater instance ready for templating operations.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: create
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Creates a pristine, blank PowerPoint presentation entirely from scratch in memory. Synthesizes a valid default PresentationML package structure with 16:9 widescreen dimensions, standard master slides, slide layouts, and minimal theme definitions.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Creates a pristine, blank PowerPoint presentation entirely from scratch in memory. Synthesizes a valid default PresentationML package structure with 16:9 widescreen dimensions, standard master slides, slide layouts, and minimal theme definitions.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Synthesizes clean [Content_Types].xml, default slide master (ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml), layout mappings, and blank ppt/presentation.xml.

returns.description: Resolves to a new PPTXTemplater instance initialized with a blank presentation deck.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: fromPresentationXml
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Instantiates a template engine instance from pre-extracted or virtual XML parts. Useful for microservice pipelines that store and mutate unpacked OpenXML files in distributed key-value caches or object storage.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Instantiates a template engine instance from pre-extracted or virtual XML parts. Useful for microservice pipelines that store and mutate unpacked OpenXML files in distributed key-value caches or object storage.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Bypasses zip extraction; mounts raw PresentationML strings into in-memory VirtualFileSystem.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Virtual file system map or configuration containing raw OpenXML parts.

parameters.name: options.files
parameters.description: Key-value map of OpenXML part paths to file contents.

returns.description: Resolves to an operational PPTXTemplater instance backed by the supplied virtual XML parts.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: preload
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Pre-reads, inflates, and caches a PPTX template into a high-speed memory cache. Subsequent calls to PPTXTemplater.fromCache() clone this pre-parsed memory state directly, eliminating disk reads and zip decompression overhead.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Pre-reads, inflates, and caches a PPTX template into a high-speed memory cache. Subsequent calls to PPTXTemplater.fromCache() clone this pre-parsed memory state directly, eliminating disk reads and zip decompression overhead.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Caches inflated OpenXML parts in memory; avoids repeating JSZip.loadAsync on heavy batch jobs.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Template file path or binary Buffer to inflate and cache.

returns.description: Resolves to the preloaded VirtualFileSystem representation stored in the global cache.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: fromCache
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Instantiates a new PPTXTemplater by deep-cloning an existing preloaded template cache. Delivers up to 10x higher throughput for concurrent report generation in high-concurrency API servers and cloud functions.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Instantiates a new PPTXTemplater by deep-cloning an existing preloaded template cache. Delivers up to 10x higher throughput for concurrent report generation in high-concurrency API servers and cloud functions.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Fast deep-copies the virtual OpenXML byte tree without reading from disk or re-parsing the zip container.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Cache key (file path string or Buffer identifier) previously passed to preload().

returns.description: Resolves to an isolated, ready-to-mutate PPTXTemplater instance.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: clearCache
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Clears all cached template packages from memory. Ideal for test teardown, memory reclamation, or when template files on disk have been hot-reloaded.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Clears all cached template packages from memory. Ideal for test teardown, memory reclamation, or when template files on disk have been hot-reloaded.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Flushes global in-memory maps holding pre-inflated OpenXML byte arrays.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: saveToFile
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the entire in-memory PresentationML package, generates a standardized PKZip archive with DEFLATE compression, and writes the output file to disk. Creates any missing parent directories automatically.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Serializes the entire in-memory PresentationML package, generates a standardized PKZip archive with DEFLATE compression, and writes the output file to disk. Creates any missing parent directories automatically.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Recompresses all modified XML parts (ppt/slides/slide*.xml, [Content_Types].xml, etc.) into compliant binary PPTX container.

parameters.name: outputPath
parameters.description: Target destination file path where the generated .pptx will be saved.

parameters.name: options.compressionLevel
parameters.description: Zip compression level from 1 (fastest) to 9 (maximum compression).

returns.description: Resolves once the file stream has completely flushed and closed on disk.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: save
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Convenience alias for saveToFile(outputPath, options). Writes the serialized presentation package to disk.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Convenience alias for saveToFile(outputPath, options). Writes the serialized presentation package to disk.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Delegates to saveToFile; re-packages all DrawingML and PresentationML parts into a binary archive.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toBuffer
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the entire PowerPoint presentation into an in-memory Node.js binary Buffer. Essential for serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Vercel Functions, Google Cloud Run) where local disk writes are prohibited or ephemeral.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Serializes the entire PowerPoint presentation into an in-memory Node.js binary Buffer. Essential for serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Vercel Functions, Google Cloud Run) where local disk writes are prohibited or ephemeral.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Compresses all OpenXML package parts directly into memory without touching the filesystem.

returns.description: Resolves to a binary Node.js Buffer containing the complete, valid .pptx file.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toStream
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Returns a Node.js Readable stream emitting binary chunks of the compressed PPTX archive. Enables streaming responses with low memory footprints when producing massive decks.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Returns a Node.js Readable stream emitting binary chunks of the compressed PPTX archive. Enables streaming responses with low memory footprints when producing massive decks.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Streams zipped binary data directly from internal archive compression pipeline.

returns.description: Resolves to a Readable stream emitting binary chunks of the presentation.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toBase64
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the presentation archive and returns it as a Base64 string or full Data URI string (data:application/vnd...;base64,...). Ideal for JSON API responses, client downloads, or webhook payloads.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Serializes the presentation archive and returns it as a Base64 string or full Data URI string (data:application/vnd...;base64,...). Ideal for JSON API responses, client downloads, or webhook payloads.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Converts in-memory zipped binary buffer into Base64 encoding.

parameters.name: options.dataUri
parameters.description: When true, prepends MIME type data URI scheme.

returns.description: Resolves to the base64-encoded presentation string.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toExpress
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Streams the presentation directly to an Express.js response object. Automatically sets the correct OpenXML MIME type (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation), Content-Disposition attachment header with encoded filename, and Content-Length.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Streams the presentation directly to an Express.js response object. Automatically sets the correct OpenXML MIME type (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation), Content-Disposition attachment header with encoded filename, and Content-Length.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Direct HTTP response serialization with standardized OpenXML MIME headers.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Filename suggested to the user client browser for download.

returns.description: Resolves when the response transmission completes.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: saveToFolder
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Unpacks and writes all internal OpenXML files, media assets, and relationships as formatted files on disk. Extremely useful for Git-based version control of PowerPoint templates, diffing changes, and low-level debugging.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Unpacks and writes all internal OpenXML files, media assets, and relationships as formatted files on disk. Extremely useful for Git-based version control of PowerPoint templates, diffing changes, and low-level debugging.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Writes unpacked folders: _rels/, docProps/, ppt/slides/, ppt/charts/, ppt/media/ with pretty-printed XML.

returns.description: Resolves once all XML and binary parts are extracted and written.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: buildPptx
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Compiles an extracted OpenXML directory back into a valid, zipped PowerPoint presentation file. Guarantees proper zip compression and relationship integrity.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Compiles an extracted OpenXML directory back into a valid, zipped PowerPoint presentation file. Guarantees proper zip compression and relationship integrity.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Scans directory, preserves binary media bytes, and zips back to compliant PresentationML package.

parameters.name: folderPath
parameters.description: Source folder containing extracted OpenXML files.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: extractPptx
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Unpacks a binary .pptx file into a folder of formatted OpenXML documents for automated inspection, security auditing, or batch transformation.
Lifecycle & I/O.rawDescription: Unpacks a binary .pptx file into a folder of formatted OpenXML documents for automated inspection, security auditing, or batch transformation.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Extracts and formats [Content_Types].xml, ppt/presentation.xml, slide XML, and relationships.

parameters.name: destinationFolder
parameters.description: Destination folder for unpacked OpenXML assets.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toArrayBuffer
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes presentation into a raw in-memory ArrayBuffer, ideal for Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, and Fetch API streaming.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXml: Flushes VirtualFileSystem into an uncompressed or compressed PKZip ArrayBuffer payload.

returns.description: Resolves to binary ArrayBuffer representing the PPTX archive.

Lifecycle & I/O.exampleCode:
const arrayBuffer = await ppt.toArrayBuffer();
return new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation' } });

Slides.name: useSlide
Slides.description: Directs subsequent slide-level operations (replacements, shape mutations, table updates, chart refreshes) to a specific 1-based slide index.
Slides.rawDescription: Directs subsequent slide-level operations (replacements, shape mutations, table updates, chart refreshes) to a specific 1-based slide index.

Slides.name: useAllSlides
Slides.description: Switches the operation scope to target every slide currently present in the presentation deck. Operations like replaceText will execute across all slides.
Slides.rawDescription: Switches the operation scope to target every slide currently present in the presentation deck. Operations like replaceText will execute across all slides.
Slides.openXml: Iterates through all  elements listed in ppt/presentation.xml .

Slides.name: addSlide
Slides.description: Creates and appends a new blank slide to the end of the presentation. Automatically assigns a new relationship ID, links the slide layout part, and updates [Content_Types].xml.
Slides.rawDescription: Creates and appends a new blank slide to the end of the presentation. Automatically assigns a new relationship ID, links the slide layout part, and updates [Content_Types].xml.
Slides.openXml: Generates ppt/slides/slide{N}.xml, ppt/slides/_rels/slide{N}.xml.rels, appends  in presentation.xml, and registers in [Content_Types].xml.

parameters.name: options.layoutNumber
parameters.description: Target slide layout index to link as parent.

returns.description: Object containing 1-based slide index and assigned relationship ID.

Slides.name: insertSlide
Slides.description: Inserts a new slide at a specific 1-based position within the presentation sequence, shifting subsequent slide entries accordingly.
Slides.rawDescription: Inserts a new slide at a specific 1-based position within the presentation sequence, shifting subsequent slide entries accordingly.
Slides.openXml: Splices a new  into  in ppt/presentation.xml at the requested position.

parameters.name: slideNumber
parameters.description: 1-based index where the new slide should be inserted.

Slides.name: duplicateSlide
Slides.description: Deep-clones an existing slide including all shapes, charts, tables, media, relationships, and layout bindings. Cloned parts receive newly generated unique relationship IDs to guarantee non-corrupted PresentationML structures.
Slides.rawDescription: Deep-clones an existing slide including all shapes, charts, tables, media, relationships, and layout bindings. Cloned parts receive newly generated unique relationship IDs to guarantee non-corrupted PresentationML structures.
Slides.openXml: Clones ppt/slides/slide{N}.xml, duplicates slide{N}.xml.rels, deep-copies linked charts/drawings, updates [Content_Types].xml and presentation.xml.

parameters.name: insertAfterIndex
parameters.description: 1-based slide index after which the duplicate will be placed.

returns.description: Metadata with newly created slide index.

Slides.name: removeSlide
Slides.description: Removes a slide from the presentation by 1-based index. Deletes the corresponding  in presentation.xml, removes the relationship in presentation.xml.rels, and cleans up orphaned slide XML and relationship parts.
Slides.rawDescription: Removes a slide from the presentation by 1-based index. Deletes the corresponding in presentation.xml, removes the relationship in presentation.xml.rels, and cleans up orphaned slide XML and relationship parts.
Slides.openXml: Deletes , unlinks relationship in presentation.xml.rels, removes slide{N}.xml and slide{N}.xml.rels.
Slides.exampleCode:
// Remove temporary instruction slide
await ppt.removeSlide(1);

Slides.name: getSlides
Slides.description: Returns metadata for all slides currently configured in the presentation deck in their visual presentation order.
Slides.rawDescription: Returns metadata for all slides currently configured in the presentation deck in their visual presentation order.
Slides.openXml: Reads  in ppt/presentation.xml and resolves target slide part names.

returns.description: Array of slide descriptors with 1-based slideNumber, rId, and partName.

Slides.exampleCode:
const slides = ppt.getSlides();
console.log(`Presentation has ${slides.length} slides:`, slides);

Slides.name: getSlideDimensions
Slides.description: Inspects and returns the physical slide dimensions and aspect ratio configured for the presentation in inches, points, pixels, and EMUs.
Slides.rawDescription: Inspects and returns the physical slide dimensions and aspect ratio configured for the presentation in inches, points, pixels, and EMUs.

returns.description: Dimensions object with width, height, widthEmu, heightEmu, and aspect ratio type (e.g. "screen16x9").

Slides.exampleCode:
const dims = ppt.getSlideDimensions();
console.log(`Slide width: ${dims.width}in, height: ${dims.height}in (type: ${dims.type})`);

Slides.name: getSlideLayout
Slides.description: Resolves and returns the layout metadata associated with a targeted slide, including layout name, type, and parent slide master reference.
Slides.rawDescription: Resolves and returns the layout metadata associated with a targeted slide, including layout name, type, and parent slide master reference.
Slides.openXml: Follows relationship in slide{N}.xml.rels to ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout{M}.xml.
Slides.exampleCode:
const layout = ppt.getSlideLayout(1);
console.log(`Slide 1 uses layout: ${layout.name} (master: ${layout.master})`);

Slides.name: importSlideFrom
Slides.description: Imports a complete slide from another independent PPTXTemplater instance. Resolves, clones, and deep-remaps all dependencies (slide layouts, media files, embedded charts, hyperlinks) into the target deck while preventing relationship collisions.
Slides.rawDescription: Imports a complete slide from another independent PPTXTemplater instance. Resolves, clones, and deep-remaps all dependencies (slide layouts, media files, embedded charts, hyperlinks) into the target deck while preventing relationship collisions.
Slides.openXml: Transfers external slide XML, re-indexes relationships in slide{N}.xml.rels, syncs [Content_Types].xml, and transfers media parts.

parameters.name: sourceSlideNumber
parameters.description: 1-based slide index in source presentation to import.

returns.description: Imported slide descriptor with new slideIndex and rId.

Slides.name: exportSlides
Slides.description: Extracts a subset of slides from the current deck and returns a new, fully self-contained PPTXTemplater instance containing only those slides, preserving all required masters, themes, and media.
Slides.rawDescription: Extracts a subset of slides from the current deck and returns a new, fully self-contained PPTXTemplater instance containing only those slides, preserving all required masters, themes, and media.
Slides.openXml: Constructs a new PresentationML package containing selected slides and pruned masters/layouts.

parameters.name: slideNumbers
parameters.description: One or more 1-based slide indices to export.

returns.description: New independent PPTXTemplater instance containing extracted slides.

Slides.name: deleteSlide
Slides.description: Removes a slide from the presentation by 1-based index and purges its relationships and layout mappings from internal manifests.
Slides.openXml: Purges slide ID from ppt/presentation.xml and removes ppt/slides/slideN.xml and .rels.

Text.name: replaceText
Text.description: Replaces template placeholders across targeted slides. Analyzes DrawingML AST paragraphs (<a:p>) and unifies fragmented text runs (<a:r> / <a:t>) split across spellchecks or editing sessions before substituting values.
Text.rawDescription: Replaces template placeholders across targeted slides. Analyzes DrawingML AST paragraphs (<a:p>) and unifies fragmented text runs (<a:r> / <a:t>) split across spellchecks or editing sessions before substituting values.
Text.openXml: Parses <a:p> and <a:r>, joins adjacent <a:t> text nodes, preserves original <a:rPr> formatting, and updates slide XML.

Text.name: replaceMultiple
Text.description: Batch-replaces multiple placeholders across all targeted slides in a single optimized pass. Automatically wraps raw keys in {{...}} if delimiters are omitted.
Text.rawDescription: Batch-replaces multiple placeholders across all targeted slides in a single optimized pass. Automatically wraps raw keys in {{...}} if delimiters are omitted.
Text.openXml: Traverses slide AST, normalizes placeholder tokens, and mutates <a:t> elements.

parameters.name: replacements
parameters.description: Map of keys to replacement strings or numbers.

Text.name: replaceTextByTag
Text.description: Replaces a single placeholder tag across targeted slides while rigorously preserving original run formatting properties (font typeface, size, color, bold, italics).
Text.rawDescription: Replaces a single placeholder tag across targeted slides while rigorously preserving original run formatting properties (font typeface, size, color, bold, italics).
Text.openXml: Modifies targeted <a:t> run nodes under <a:p> without altering adjacent <a:rPr> tags.

Text.name: updateText
Text.description: Updates text content or synthesizes hierarchical bullet/numbered lists inside a shape or text frame by shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.
Text.rawDescription: Updates text content or synthesizes hierarchical bullet/numbered lists inside a shape or text frame by shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.
Text.openXml: Replaces paragraph text or synthesizes <a:pPr> bullet properties (<a:buChar>, <a:buAutoNum>, @_lvl, @_marL).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.

parameters.name: valueOrListConfig
parameters.description: Plain text string or structured list configuration object.

Text.name: findText
Text.description: Searches for text occurrences across targeted slides. Scans all shapes, text boxes, and tables, returning match locations with slide index and shape identifiers.
Text.rawDescription: Searches for text occurrences across targeted slides. Scans all shapes, text boxes, and tables, returning match locations with slide index and shape identifiers.

returns.description: List of matches with slide numbers and shape names.

Text.exampleCode:
const matches = ppt.findText('ARR');
matches.forEach(m => console.log(`Found "${m.text}" on slide ${m.slideIndex} in shape "${m.shapeName}"`));

Text.name: appendTextRun
Text.description: Appends a new styled text run (<a:r>) to the end of the text frame of an existing shape. Supports custom font family, size, solid fill color, bold, italics, underline, and strike.
Text.rawDescription: Appends a new styled text run (<a:r>) to the end of the text frame of an existing shape. Supports custom font family, size, solid fill color, bold, italics, underline, and strike.
Text.openXml: Appends <a:r> with <a:rPr> (@_sz, @_b, <a:solidFill>) to the last <a:p> in <p:txBody>.

Text.name: prependTextRun
Text.description: Inserts a new styled text run at the very beginning of a shape's text frame, before all existing paragraphs and runs.
Text.rawDescription: Inserts a new styled text run at the very beginning of a shape's text frame, before all existing paragraphs and runs.

Text.name: extractPlaceholders
Text.description: Scans all text runs across targeted slides and extracts a unique list of all placeholder tokens matching the pattern (defaults to /\{\{([^\{\}]+)\}\}/g). Useful for validating payload completeness before template rendering.
Text.rawDescription: Scans all text runs across targeted slides and extracts a unique list of all placeholder tokens matching the pattern (defaults to /\{\{([^\{\}]+)\}\}/g). Useful for validating payload completeness before template rendering.
Text.openXml: Parses all <a:t> elements across active slide XML parts.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Custom regular expression for placeholder detection.

returns.description: Array of unique placeholder tokens found.

Text.name: getList
Text.description: Extracts existing bulleted and numbered items from a shape or text box, returning each line with its hierarchical indentation level.
Text.rawDescription: Extracts existing bulleted and numbered items from a shape or text box, returning each line with its hierarchical indentation level.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Shape name, shape ID, or placeholder tag.

returns.description: Array of items with text and 0-based indentation level.

Text.name: validateList
Text.description: Validates a structured list configuration before injecting it into slide XML. Checks list depth, text integrity, and bullet formatting parameters.
Text.rawDescription: Validates a structured list configuration before injecting it into slide XML. Checks list depth, text integrity, and bullet formatting parameters.
Text.openXml: Schema verification utility for DrawingML paragraph properties.

parameters.name: listConfig
parameters.description: List configuration object with list array and optional style.

Text.exampleCode:
const result = PPTXTemplater.validateList({ list: ['Item 1', 'Item 2'] });
if (!result.valid) console.error('List errors:', result.errors);

Tables.name: addTable
Tables.description: Creates a brand-new table on the active slide. Generates DrawingML table structure (<a:tbl>) with customizable row count, column count, column widths, coordinates, styles, and initial data matrix.
Tables.rawDescription: Creates a brand-new table on the active slide. Generates DrawingML table structure (<a:tbl>) with customizable row count, column count, column widths, coordinates, styles, and initial data matrix.

parameters.name: tableIdOrOptions
parameters.description: Table identifier name or full configuration options.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Table configuration (rows, cols, x, y, width, height, data).

returns.description: Resolves to the newly created table shape ID.

Tables.name: updateTable
Tables.description: Replaces table cell values with a 2D array matrix of strings or numbers. Matches existing rows and columns while preserving all existing cell formatting (background fills, fonts, borders, alignments).
Tables.rawDescription: Replaces table cell values with a 2D array matrix of strings or numbers. Matches existing rows and columns while preserving all existing cell formatting (background fills, fonts, borders, alignments).
Tables.openXml: Iterates existing <a:tr> and <a:tc> elements, updating text run values in <a:t>.

Tables.name: getTableRows
Tables.description: Extracts data from an existing table on the active slide. Can return rows as structured JSON objects (using header row values as object keys) or as raw 2D string matrices.
Tables.rawDescription: Extracts data from an existing table on the active slide. Can return rows as structured JSON objects (using header row values as object keys) or as raw 2D string matrices.
Tables.openXml: Parses <a:tbl> cells and extracts text from <a:t> elements.

parameters.name: options.asObjects
parameters.description: When true, formats rows as JSON objects using table headers.

returns.description: Array of extracted table row records.

Tables.name: addTableRow
Tables.description: Appends a new row to an existing table. Supports nested arrays for multi-row merging (rowspan), automatic cell styling, custom background fills, and borders.
Tables.rawDescription: Appends a new row to an existing table. Supports nested arrays for multi-row merging (rowspan), automatic cell styling, custom background fills, and borders.
Tables.openXml: Synthesizes and appends <a:tr> containing <a:tc> cells into <a:tbl>.

parameters.name: rowData
parameters.description: Array of cell values for the new row.

Tables.name: mergeCells
Tables.description: Merges a rectangular block of cells across rows and/or columns. Applies compliant OpenXML rowspan and colspan attributes (rowSpan, gridSpan, hMerge, vMerge) without corrupting PowerPoint.
Tables.rawDescription: Merges a rectangular block of cells across rows and/or columns. Applies compliant OpenXML rowspan and colspan attributes (rowSpan, gridSpan, hMerge, vMerge) without corrupting PowerPoint.
Tables.exampleCode:
// Merge header cells across columns 1 to 3
await ppt.useSlide(1).mergeCells('financials_table', 0, 1, 0, 3);

Tables.name: cloneMergedRegion
Tables.description: Replicates an existing merged cell topology across multiple contiguous rows or columns.
Tables.rawDescription: Replicates an existing merged cell topology across multiple contiguous rows or columns.
Tables.openXml: Copies <a:tcPr> merge flags across corresponding row indices in <a:tbl>.

Tables.name: autoFitTable
Tables.description: Automatically calculates and distributes column widths in <a:tblGrid> based on text length and typography metrics, preventing awkward text wrapping.
Tables.rawDescription: Automatically calculates and distributes column widths in <a:tblGrid> based on text length and typography metrics, preventing awkward text wrapping.

Tables.name: splitTableOnOverflow
Tables.description: Automatically splits large tables across consecutive duplicate slides when table height exceeds a slide threshold. Preserves repeated headers across all generated slides and keeps summary/totals rows pinned to the final slide.
Tables.rawDescription: Automatically splits large tables across consecutive duplicate slides when table height exceeds a slide threshold. Preserves repeated headers across all generated slides and keeps summary/totals rows pinned to the final slide.
Tables.openXml: Calculates cumulative row heights in EMUs, duplicates slide XML, chunks <a:tr> rows, and syncs slide relationships.

parameters.name: options.bottomMargin
parameters.description: Bottom margin threshold for triggering split.

parameters.name: options.repeatHeaders
parameters.description: Number of header rows to repeat on each split slide.

parameters.name: options.summaryRows
parameters.description: Number of summary rows to preserve on the final slide.

returns.description: Pagination outcome with splitCount and slidesCreated.

Charts.name: updateChart
Charts.description: Updates chart categories, series names, and numerical values on the active slide. Simultaneously synchronizes both the DrawingML ChartSpace XML (ppt/charts/chart{N}.xml) and the embedded Excel worksheet data cache (ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet{N}.xlsx), preventing PowerPoint "Repair Workbook" warnings.
Charts.rawDescription: Updates chart categories, series names, and numerical values on the active slide. Simultaneously synchronizes both the DrawingML ChartSpace XML (ppt/charts/chart{N}.xml) and the embedded Excel worksheet data cache (ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet{N}.xlsx), preventing PowerPoint "Repair Workbook" warnings.
Charts.openXml: Mutates <c:chartSpace> (<c:ser>, <c:cat>, <c:val>, <c:numCache>) and updates embedded Excel sheet data.

parameters.name: chartId
parameters.description: Chart title, shape name, or chart relationship ID.

parameters.name: data.series
parameters.description: Array of data series with name and numerical values.

Charts.name: updateChartCategories
Charts.description: Updates category labels along the chart axis without altering series data values. Updates both chart XML string cache and Excel worksheet row/column headers.
Charts.rawDescription: Updates category labels along the chart axis without altering series data values. Updates both chart XML string cache and Excel worksheet row/column headers.
Charts.openXml: Mutates <c:cat> <c:strCache> in chart{N}.xml and updates embedded Excel cells.

Charts.name: updateChartTitle
Charts.description: Updates the title text displayed on a chart while preserving existing title typography, rotation, and font styling.
Charts.rawDescription: Updates the title text displayed on a chart while preserving existing title typography, rotation, and font styling.

Charts.name: updateDataLabels
Charts.description: Controls chart data label display visibility and formatting. Toggles value display, category names, series names, percentages, and legend keys.
Charts.rawDescription: Controls chart data label display visibility and formatting. Toggles value display, category names, series names, percentages, and legend keys.

Charts.name: repairCharts
Charts.description: Audits and repairs chart XML inconsistencies, missing Excel workbook relationships, or corrupt formula ranges across all charts in the presentation.
Charts.rawDescription: Audits and repairs chart XML inconsistencies, missing Excel workbook relationships, or corrupt formula ranges across all charts in the presentation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an existing PowerPoint template from a file path string, in-memory Node.js Buffer, or stream. Inflates the PKZip container, parses package relationships (_rels/.rels), validates [Content_Types].xml, and mounts the PresentationML virtual file system.
methods.rawDescription: Loads an existing PowerPoint template from a file path string, in-memory Node.js Buffer, or stream. Inflates the PKZip container, parses package relationships (_rels/.rels), validates [Content_Types].xml, and mounts the PresentationML virtual file system.
methods.openXml: Reads ZIP archive entries: [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, ppt/presentation.xml, ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: File path on disk or Buffer containing raw PPTX binary archive.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configuration options for parser and logger.

parameters.name: options.logLevel
parameters.description: Logging verbosity level during parsing and manipulations.

returns.description: Resolves to an initialized, chainable PPTXTemplater instance ready for templating operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a pristine, blank PowerPoint presentation entirely from scratch in memory. Synthesizes a valid default PresentationML package structure with 16:9 widescreen dimensions, standard master slides, slide layouts, and minimal theme definitions.
methods.rawDescription: Creates a pristine, blank PowerPoint presentation entirely from scratch in memory. Synthesizes a valid default PresentationML package structure with 16:9 widescreen dimensions, standard master slides, slide layouts, and minimal theme definitions.
methods.openXml: Synthesizes clean [Content_Types].xml, default slide master (ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml), layout mappings, and blank ppt/presentation.xml.

returns.description: Resolves to a new PPTXTemplater instance initialized with a blank presentation deck.

methods.name: fromPresentationXml
methods.description: Instantiates a template engine instance from pre-extracted or virtual XML parts. Useful for microservice pipelines that store and mutate unpacked OpenXML files in distributed key-value caches or object storage.
methods.rawDescription: Instantiates a template engine instance from pre-extracted or virtual XML parts. Useful for microservice pipelines that store and mutate unpacked OpenXML files in distributed key-value caches or object storage.
methods.openXml: Bypasses zip extraction; mounts raw PresentationML strings into in-memory VirtualFileSystem.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Virtual file system map or configuration containing raw OpenXML parts.

parameters.name: options.files
parameters.description: Key-value map of OpenXML part paths to file contents.

returns.description: Resolves to an operational PPTXTemplater instance backed by the supplied virtual XML parts.

methods.name: preload
methods.description: Pre-reads, inflates, and caches a PPTX template into a high-speed memory cache. Subsequent calls to PPTXTemplater.fromCache() clone this pre-parsed memory state directly, eliminating disk reads and zip decompression overhead.
methods.rawDescription: Pre-reads, inflates, and caches a PPTX template into a high-speed memory cache. Subsequent calls to PPTXTemplater.fromCache() clone this pre-parsed memory state directly, eliminating disk reads and zip decompression overhead.
methods.openXml: Caches inflated OpenXML parts in memory; avoids repeating JSZip.loadAsync on heavy batch jobs.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Template file path or binary Buffer to inflate and cache.

returns.description: Resolves to the preloaded VirtualFileSystem representation stored in the global cache.

methods.name: fromCache
methods.description: Instantiates a new PPTXTemplater by deep-cloning an existing preloaded template cache. Delivers up to 10x higher throughput for concurrent report generation in high-concurrency API servers and cloud functions.
methods.rawDescription: Instantiates a new PPTXTemplater by deep-cloning an existing preloaded template cache. Delivers up to 10x higher throughput for concurrent report generation in high-concurrency API servers and cloud functions.
methods.openXml: Fast deep-copies the virtual OpenXML byte tree without reading from disk or re-parsing the zip container.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Cache key (file path string or Buffer identifier) previously passed to preload().

returns.description: Resolves to an isolated, ready-to-mutate PPTXTemplater instance.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears all cached template packages from memory. Ideal for test teardown, memory reclamation, or when template files on disk have been hot-reloaded.
methods.rawDescription: Clears all cached template packages from memory. Ideal for test teardown, memory reclamation, or when template files on disk have been hot-reloaded.
methods.openXml: Flushes global in-memory maps holding pre-inflated OpenXML byte arrays.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Serializes the entire in-memory PresentationML package, generates a standardized PKZip archive with DEFLATE compression, and writes the output file to disk. Creates any missing parent directories automatically.
methods.rawDescription: Serializes the entire in-memory PresentationML package, generates a standardized PKZip archive with DEFLATE compression, and writes the output file to disk. Creates any missing parent directories automatically.
methods.openXml: Recompresses all modified XML parts (ppt/slides/slide*.xml, [Content_Types].xml, etc.) into compliant binary PPTX container.

parameters.name: outputPath

parameters.name: options.compressionLevel
parameters.description: Zip compression level from 1 (fastest) to 9 (maximum compression).

returns.description: Resolves once the file stream has completely flushed and closed on disk.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Convenience alias for saveToFile(outputPath, options). Writes the serialized presentation package to disk.
methods.rawDescription: Convenience alias for saveToFile(outputPath, options). Writes the serialized presentation package to disk.

methods.name: toBuffer

methods.rawDescription: Serializes the entire PowerPoint presentation into an in-memory Node.js binary Buffer. Essential for serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Vercel Functions, Google Cloud Run) where local disk writes are prohibited or ephemeral.

methods.openXml: Repositions the element XML node to the end of child elements in <p:spTree>.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).bringToFront('active_badge');

methods.name: sendToBack
methods.description: Moves an object to the bottom of the visual stacking order, behind all other shapes and content on the active slide.
methods.rawDescription: Moves an object to the bottom of the visual stacking order, behind all other shapes and content on the active slide.
methods.openXml: Repositions element XML node to the beginning of child elements in <p:spTree>.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).sendToBack('background_card');

methods.name: bringForward
methods.description: Increments the visual layer of an object by one step in the stacking hierarchy.
methods.rawDescription: Increments the visual layer of an object by one step in the stacking hierarchy.
methods.openXml: Swaps element node with its immediate next sibling in <p:spTree>.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).bringForward('icon_overlay');

methods.name: sendBackward
methods.description: Decrements the visual layer of an object by one step in the stacking hierarchy.
methods.rawDescription: Decrements the visual layer of an object by one step in the stacking hierarchy.
methods.openXml: Swaps element node with its immediate previous sibling in <p:spTree>.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).sendBackward('shadow_shape');

methods.name: setZIndex
methods.description: Moves an object to an explicit 0-based position in the visual stack array.
methods.rawDescription: Moves an object to an explicit 0-based position in the visual stack array.
methods.openXml: Slices and splices object node within <p:spTree> child nodes array.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).setZIndex('watermark', 0);

methods.name: reorderObjects
methods.description: Re-orders all objects on the active slide according to an explicit back-to-front array of IDs.
methods.rawDescription: Re-orders all objects on the active slide according to an explicit back-to-front array of IDs.
methods.openXml: Re-sorts child nodes of <p:spTree> matching the order of orderedIds.

parameters.name: orderedIds
parameters.description: Array of object IDs ordered from bottom-most to top-most.

methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).reorderObjects(['bg', 'chart1', 'overlay', 'title']);

methods.name: swapObjects
methods.description: Swaps the visual layers of two specified objects.
methods.rawDescription: Swaps the visual layers of two specified objects.
methods.openXml: Exchanges position indices of two nodes within <p:spTree>.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).swapObjects('shapeA', 'shapeB');

methods.name: getObjectOrder
methods.description: Returns the current back-to-front visual order of object IDs on the active slide.
methods.rawDescription: Returns the current back-to-front visual order of object IDs on the active slide.
methods.openXml: Maps child node IDs in <p:spTree>.

returns.description: Array of object IDs in layer order.

methods.exampleCode:
const order = ppt.useSlide(1).getObjectOrder();
console.log('Stacking order:', order);

methods.name: normalizeZOrder
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans shape IDs and child node ordering to prevent Office repair warnings after heavy additions and deletions.
methods.rawDescription: Normalizes and cleans shape IDs and child node ordering to prevent Office repair warnings after heavy additions and deletions.
methods.openXml: Recompacts shape IDs and structural ordering in <p:spTree>.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).normalizeZOrder();

methods.name: addHyperlink
methods.description: Attaches an external web URL hyperlink to a text run or shape. Creates an external relationship in slide{N}.xml.rels and registers the click action.
methods.rawDescription: Attaches an external web URL hyperlink to a text run or shape. Creates an external relationship in slide{N}.xml.rels and registers the click action.
methods.openXml: Adds <a:hlinkClick r:id="rId..."/> under <a:rPr> and registers relationship in slide{N}.xml.rels with TargetMode="External".

parameters.name: options.text
parameters.description: Specific text substring to attach link to.

methods.name: addSlideLink
methods.description: Creates an internal navigation jump link that transitions the slideshow presentation directly to another specified slide index when clicked.
methods.rawDescription: Creates an internal navigation jump link that transitions the slideshow presentation directly to another specified slide index when clicked.
methods.openXml: Appends <a:hlinkClick action="ppaction://hlinksldjump" r:id="rId..."/> linked to target slide relationship.

parameters.name: options.targetSlide
parameters.description: 1-based target slide index to navigate to.

methods.name: addImageLink
methods.description: Attaches an external web hyperlink action to an image or picture element on the active slide.
methods.rawDescription: Attaches an external web hyperlink action to an image or picture element on the active slide.
methods.openXml: Attaches <a:hlinkClick r:id="..."/> under <p:cNvPr> inside <p:pic>.

parameters.name: imageId
parameters.description: Image shape ID or picture name.

methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).addImageLink('logo_img', 'https://github.com/jsuyog2/node-pptx-templater');

methods.name: addShapeLink
methods.description: Attaches an external web click action to an entire vector shape.
methods.rawDescription: Attaches an external web click action to an entire vector shape.
methods.openXml: Mutates <p:cNvPr> in <p:nvSpPr> and links external URL relationship.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).addShapeLink('cta_button', 'https://company.com/signup');

methods.name: addTextNavigationLink
methods.description: Creates an internal slide jump link on a specific text run inside a shape.
methods.rawDescription: Creates an internal slide jump link on a specific text run inside a shape.
methods.openXml: Adds ppaction://hlinksldjump to targeted <a:rPr>.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(2).addTextNavigationLink('agenda_box', 5, { text: 'Financials' });

methods.name: addShapeNavigationLink
methods.description: Makes an entire vector shape trigger navigation to another slide when clicked.
methods.rawDescription: Makes an entire vector shape trigger navigation to another slide when clicked.
methods.openXml: Applies internal jump click action to shape <p:cNvPr>.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).addShapeNavigationLink('next_button', 2);

methods.name: getHyperlinks
methods.description: Extracts and lists all internal and external hyperlinks defined on the specified slide.
methods.rawDescription: Extracts and lists all internal and external hyperlinks defined on the specified slide.
methods.openXml: Scans slide{N}.xml.rels and matches <a:hlinkClick> tags.
methods.exampleCode:
const links = ppt.useSlide(1).getHyperlinks();
console.log('Slide 1 links:', links);

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive integrity check of the entire PowerPoint package. Verifies PresentationML schemas, checks all XML tags for balanced closures, audits DrawingML tree structures, and ensures no dangling references exist.
methods.rawDescription: Performs a comprehensive integrity check of the entire PowerPoint package. Verifies PresentationML schemas, checks all XML tags for balanced closures, audits DrawingML tree structures, and ensures no dangling references exist.
methods.openXml: Audits [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, ppt/presentation.xml, all slides, layouts, masters, and charts.

returns.description: Validation outcome with list of any structural errors.

methods.name: validatePresentation
methods.description: Audits presentation-level structures: verifies slide ordering, checks layout linkages, and ensures master slide relationship consistency.
methods.rawDescription: Audits presentation-level structures: verifies slide ordering, checks layout linkages, and ensures master slide relationship consistency.
methods.openXml: Validates ppt/presentation.xml and ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels.
methods.exampleCode: const check = await ppt.validatePresentation();

methods.name: validateTable
methods.description: Validates a table's DrawingML grid structures, ensuring cell counts match grid columns and merge coordinates do not overlap or exceed table boundaries.
methods.rawDescription: Validates a table's DrawingML grid structures, ensuring cell counts match grid columns and merge coordinates do not overlap or exceed table boundaries.
methods.openXml: Audits <a:tblGrid> and <a:tr> row/cell consistency.
methods.exampleCode: const res = await ppt.useSlide(1).validateTable('projectTable');

methods.name: validateRelationships
methods.description: Scans all .rels files across the presentation to ensure every relationship targets an existing package part and no unreferenced orphaned assets exist.
methods.rawDescription: Scans all .rels files across the presentation to ensure every relationship targets an existing package part and no unreferenced orphaned assets exist.
methods.openXml: Audits all _rels/*.rels files against package file entries.

returns.description: Audit result with orphaned and missing target lists.

methods.exampleCode:
const relsAudit = await ppt.validateRelationships();
console.log('Orphaned parts:', relsAudit.orphaned);

methods.name: repair
methods.description: Automatically analyzes and repairs common PowerPoint corruption triggers: fixes orphaned relationship IDs, resolves unclosed XML run tags, regenerates missing Content-Type entries, and normalizes table structures.
methods.rawDescription: Automatically analyzes and repairs common PowerPoint corruption triggers: fixes orphaned relationship IDs, resolves unclosed XML run tags, regenerates missing Content-Type entries, and normalizes table structures.
methods.openXml: Corrects [Content_Types].xml, trims broken .rels links, and repairs corrupted DrawingML trees.

methods.name: inspectXML
methods.description: Returns the formatted, syntax-indented XML content of any internal part in the presentation package (e.g. ppt/slides/slide1.xml).
methods.rawDescription: Returns the formatted, syntax-indented XML content of any internal part in the presentation package (e.g. ppt/slides/slide1.xml).
methods.openXml: Reads and pretty-prints raw XML part string.

parameters.name: xmlPath
parameters.description: Relative part path inside PPTX package.

methods.exampleCode:
const slideXml = await ppt.inspectXML('ppt/slides/slide1.xml');
console.log(slideXml.substring(0, 500));

methods.name: inspectSlide
methods.description: Returns the formatted, indented XML string of a specific slide.
methods.rawDescription: Returns the formatted, indented XML string of a specific slide.
methods.openXml: Retrieves ppt/slides/slide{N}.xml.
methods.exampleCode: const xml = await ppt.inspectSlide(1);

methods.name: inspectChart
methods.description: Returns the formatted XML content of a specific chart part.
methods.rawDescription: Returns the formatted XML content of a specific chart part.
methods.openXml: Retrieves ppt/charts/chart{N}.xml.
methods.exampleCode: const chartXml = await ppt.inspectChart('chart1');

methods.name: debugRelationships
methods.description: Dumps all relationship entries linked to a specific slide, listing relationship IDs, schemas, and target files.
methods.rawDescription: Dumps all relationship entries linked to a specific slide, listing relationship IDs, schemas, and target files.
methods.openXml: Parses ppt/slides/_rels/slide{N}.xml.rels.
methods.exampleCode:
const rels = await ppt.debugRelationships(1);
console.table(rels);

methods.name: enablePerformanceProfile
methods.description: Activates microsecond performance telemetry profiling for all subsequent XML parsing, AST manipulations, and zip serialization.
methods.rawDescription: Activates microsecond performance telemetry profiling for all subsequent XML parsing, AST manipulations, and zip serialization.
methods.openXml: Hooks high-resolution timers around XML mutations and package compilation.

methods.name: getPerformanceMetrics
methods.description: Returns high-resolution timing metrics for operations performed on the presentation.
methods.rawDescription: Returns high-resolution timing metrics for operations performed on the presentation.
methods.openXml: Returns telemetry data map.

returns.description: Metrics summary object with durations in milliseconds.

methods.exampleCode: const metrics = ppt.getPerformanceMetrics();

methods.name: enableDebug
methods.description: Sets global and instance logger verbosity to debug level, printing detailed OpenXML transformation traces to stdout.
methods.rawDescription: Sets global and instance logger verbosity to debug level, printing detailed OpenXML transformation traces to stdout.
methods.openXml: Enables debug logging for all internal managers.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.enableDebug();

methods.name: toArrayBuffer
methods.description: Serializes presentation into a raw in-memory ArrayBuffer, ideal for Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, and Fetch API streaming.
methods.openXml: Flushes VirtualFileSystem into an uncompressed or compressed PKZip ArrayBuffer payload.

returns.description: Resolves to binary ArrayBuffer representing the PPTX archive.

methods.exampleCode:
const arrayBuffer = await ppt.toArrayBuffer();
return new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation' } });

methods.name: deleteSlide
methods.description: Removes a slide from the presentation by 1-based index and purges its relationships and layout mappings from internal manifests.
methods.openXml: Purges slide ID from ppt/presentation.xml and removes ppt/slides/slideN.xml and .rels.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.deleteSlide(3); // Deletes the 3rd slide

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Calculates the pixel bounding box (x, y, width, height) of an element on the currently active slide.
methods.openXml: Queries a:off (offset) and a:ext (extent) coordinates and converts EMUs to integer pixels.

returns.type: { x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number }

methods.name: setBounds
methods.description: Updates position and dimensions of an element using integer pixels or string units (e.g. "2in", "100px", "5cm").
methods.openXml: Translates units into English Metric Units (EMU) and mutates a:off / a:ext XML nodes.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.setBounds('HeaderBox', { width: '8in', height: '1.5in' });

methods.name: stepForward
methods.description: Moves an element one step forward in the visual stacking order (Z-index) within the slide shape tree.
methods.openXml: Permutes the child nodes inside p:spTree forward by one position.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).stepForward('WatermarkShape');

methods.name: stepBackward
methods.description: Moves an element one step backward in the visual stacking order (Z-index) within the slide shape tree.
methods.openXml: Permutes the child nodes inside p:spTree backward by one position.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.useSlide(1).stepBackward('OverlayBox');

methods.name: removeCellShape
methods.description: Removes an overlaid cell shape or badge from a specific table cell coordinate.
methods.openXml: Deletes associated geometric shape child in p:spTree mapped to table cell bounds.
methods.exampleCode: ppt.removeCellShape('Financials', 1, 3);
